name: Rayleigh wave velocity
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 土体表面瑞利波的传播速度。
usage_overview: 在列车—轨道—土体动力分析中，作为表征土体表面波传播的速度指标，用于与列车速度比较，分析振动响应显著增大的现象；也可通过应变峰值传播估算，并与理论值比较以核验土体模型。

complete_examples.text: Besides, it is shown that the soil vibrations will be significantly amplified once the vehicle running speed is larger than the Rayleigh wave velocity of the subgrade soil.

By substituting the subgrade parameters into Eqs. (15) and (16), the value of Rayleigh wave velocity can be obtained 465 km/h, which is close to the critical speed of 450 km/h. Example 3: The influence of different subgrade irregularity wavelengths To further illustrate the effect of subgrade irregularity on the dy namic performance of the coupled system, the wheel-rail vertical forces and stiffness reduction are calculated, where the amplitude of subgrade irregularity is 20 mm, and the wavelengths are varied from 5 m to 50 m with an interval of 5 m. The vehicle speed is 300 km/h in this case.
The critical speed of the train traveling through the track is convictive evidence: the dynamic track displacement comes to greatest once the trains/loads move close to the Rayleigh wave velocity.
For the half-space soil, the Rayleigh wave velocity simulated is used for verification, and the results are compared with the results calculated by the model established in Ref. [83].
